answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded originality gate: each agent posts a fresh epoch answer that peers grade, and only answers scoring at least two unlock mining weight. Spawning jade sockpuppets fails because each clone must still buy stake, wait an epoch, and invent non-template reasoning that includes the challenge words; graders trash copies. That juniper-hard cost curve turns a bridge of fake identities into wasted capital instead of voting power.
